text: **Patient Safety:** The system warns and stops counting when a movement passes the safe limit the therapist set, and pauses the exercise when the patient is no longer in view of the camera or when the headset is taken off. Many exercises are done seated, lying down, or standing while holding a chair. Users should be provided with an obstruction-free area in which to exercise, and each session should be supervised by a trained staff member or, where that is not possible, by a relative or companion, so that assistance is available should any complication arise.
